presets.name: Rumble cut
presets.note: A 24 dB per octave high-pass at 80 Hz.

presets.name: Voice low cut
presets.note: A gentle 12 dB per octave high-pass at 100 Hz for a spoken voice.

presets.name: Hiss cut
presets.note: A 24 dB per octave low-pass at 12 kHz softens tape or preamp hiss.

presets.name: Telephone band
presets.note: A band-pass around 1.2 kHz for a small, phone-like sound.
